title: oncall-scratchpad-2026-03-05
content:
SRE on-call scratchpad - 2026-03-05
Owner: Noah Chen
Team: eng-sre
Collaborators: Ethan Park, Mia Li
Status: draft (working notes / follow-ups)

---
Summary of incidents handled (UTC timestamps)
- 2026-03-05 02:12: PagerDuty: High5xxRate /api/generate (prod-us-east-1) - several customers saw 502/503.
  - Alert: High5xxRate (threshold 5% 1m) triggered at 02:12. Spike to ~18% 1m.
  - Initial triage: root cause appears to be a downstream timeout to vector-store shard (vs-01) causing request fanout failures and increased error propagation through gateway.
  - Actions taken:
    - 02:15: Scaled inference-service replicas from 6 -> 12 (kubectl scale deployment/inference-service --replicas=12) to absorb queue buildup.
    - 02:21: Rolled back runtime change from canary (serving-runtime:v2026-03-04-canary) to stable image v2026-02-28 (kubectl set image deployment/inference-service ...).
    - 02:35: Rebalanced traffic away from vs-01 using routing policy; temporary mitigation successful, error rate returning to baseline by 02:42.
  - PagerDuty notes: Escalated to on-call infra (Ethan) for vstore investigation; created incident INC-1324.
  - Post-incident: Created perf regression PR observed in canary: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/345

- 2026-03-05 09:40: Noisy alert duplicate - HighLatency synthetic test failing (prod-eu) - caused by bad config rollout to synthetic runner. Fixed by reverting feature flag. No customer impact.

---
Immediate follow-ups / action items (prioritized)
1) Incident postmortem (INC-1324) - owner: Noah (draft) - due 2026-03-07
   - Goal: short blameless summary, timeline, root cause (vector-store timeouts + canary perf regression), mitigation, long-term fix plan.
   - Linked JIRA: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-1324

2) Runbook updates - owner: Ethan Park / Noah - due 2026-03-10
   - Update \"High5xxRate /api/generate\" runbook: add vector-store shard fallback steps and explicit routing override commands.
   - Add exact k8s commands used today and required permissions.
   - Add metric thresholds observed (18% 1m example) and expected escalation path (when to page infra).

3) Add synthetic coverage - owner: Mia Li - due 2026-03-12
   - Add synthetic tests that exercise vector-store fallback paths and per-shard timeouts.
   - Create synthetic for long-tail latency at sequence length 2048.

4) Postmortem action: implement circuit-breaker between gateway and vector-store - owner: SRE infra team (SRE-432) - blocker: engineering prioritization.
   - Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SRE-432

5) Follow-up PR reviews: serving-runtime PR #345 needs code review and perf bench note - owner: Noah / runtime team.
   - PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/345

---
Notes / debugging commands used (for runbook)\- kubectl -n prod rollout status deploy/inference-service\- kubectl scale deploy/inference-service --replicas=12 - recorded in incident log\- curl to health endpoints /v1/health and /internal/kv/ping to check vstore connectivity\- grafana dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abcd/request-latency?var-cluster=prod-us-east-1\- occurred with runtime canary -> rolled back to v2026-02-28

Observations / open questions\- Why did vector-store shard vs-01 experience increased timeouts? Initial hypothesis: GC/maintenance on host, or network flakiness during autoscaling. Ethan is investigating host-level metrics.\- Canary build introduced a regression in the batching scheduler that increases tail latency for certain sharded requests. Need a minimal repro and perf test to validate.

Runbook TODOs (short checklist)
- [ ] Add explicit k8s rollback steps and example commands in runbook (owner: Noah)\- [ ] Document routing override to take shard out of pool (owner: Ethan)\- [ ] Add synthetic test to detect this class of failure (owner: Mia)\- [ ] Add postmortem summary and link to incident ticket on Confluence (owner: Noah)

Communication log\- 02:14 Slack: #prod-alerts \"High5xxRate on /api/generate - investigating\" (pinged runtime on-call)\- 02:18 Handoff call with runtime on-call (summary logged in INC-1324)\- 03:00 Email to customer-success for impacted tenants with temporary mitigation notes

Reminders for next on-call shift\- Walk incoming on-call through runbook updates and mitigation commands before handoff.\- Ensure PR #345 has bench numbers attached before promoting canary again.

Misc scratch notes\- Consider adding a \"canary safety\" gate in CI that runs lightweight vstore integration test.
- If we see repeated shard timeouts, consider increasing vector-store replica counts during peak windows.
